# Los Angeles County precincts

[All counties](../GIS_DATA.md)

The 32,473 precinct outlines the lookup uses, each with a description from Census TIGER 2026 (towns,
highways, streets, lakes).

**Precinct map:** [a live layer published by Los Angeles County, last edited November 2026](https://services.arcgis.com/RmCCgQtiZLDCtblq/ArcGIS/rest/services/Registrar_Recorder_Precincts/FeatureServer/0).

**Voters:** registered voters for the June 2, 2026 primary, from the [Statewide Database](https://statewidedatabase.org/)
(SWDB), which counts them for each precinct in the county's voter file, matched here by precinct number.
5,808,281 of SWDB's 5,902,096 voters are in a precinct listed here.
